files.description: Repository guidance defining this personal Strata fork (Niko1221/Strata as only upstream, XeStrata reference-only), the feature/sycl long-prefill tuning priorities and precision policy, Orca-based parallel research rules, and measurement/artifact retention procedures.

Top-level CMake build for the Strata engine (v0.1.38, C++20) that gates the CUDA/SYCL/HIP backends, defines artifact/plan/core/kernels/engine/prefill targets and their parity tests, and guards CUDA architecture support.
